description: ProGPU runtime package for GPU-accelerated .NET composition, rendering, vector graphics, text, and WebGPU platform integration.
releaseNotes: Fixes Avalonia Silk.NET DPI, live resizing, custom title-bar dragging, and routed input across Windows, macOS, and Linux. Adds exact WebGPU device-loss and surface recovery for Silk/wgpu-native and Dawn, including remote-session failures, while preserving retained rendering, clipping, and native-window ControlCatalog correctness.
